title: Quand j'étais petite
en: The imparfait: describing the past and past habits
intro: The **imparfait** is the past tense of memories: what things **were like** (*la maison était petite*) and what **used to happen** (*le dimanche, nous allions chez Mamie*). It's very regular: take the **nous** form of the present, remove **-ons**, and add **-ais, -ais, -ait, -ions, -iez, -aient**.

cases.label: the endings: -ais, -ait, -ions…
cases.rule: **nous** form of the present, minus **-ons**, + **-ais, -ais, -ait, -ions, -iez, -aient**: *nous parlons → je parlais, tu parlais, il parlait, nous parlions, vous parliez, ils parlaient*.

cases.label: être: j'étais
cases.rule: The only irregular stem: **être → ét-**: *j'étais, tu étais, il était, nous étions, vous étiez, ils étaient*. Very common: **c'était** (it was).

cases.label: habits: used to…
cases.rule: What **used to happen** again and again: *Le dimanche, nous allions chez mes grands-parents.* Signal words: *tous les jours, le lundi, souvent, toujours, d'habitude*.

cases.label: describing the past
cases.rule: Places, people and the weather in the past: *La maison était petite. Il faisait froid. Mon grand-père portait un chapeau.*

cases.label: age, feelings, wishes
cases.rule: States in the past: age (*j'avais six ans*), feelings (*j'avais peur, j'étais heureux*), wishes and tastes (*je voulais, j'aimais*).

cases.label: il y avait, c'était, il faisait
cases.rule: **il y a → il y avait**, **c'est → c'était**, **il fait → il faisait**, **il pleut → il pleuvait**.

cases.label: mangeais, commençais
cases.rule: **-ger** verbs keep an **e** before **a**: *je mangeais*. **-cer** verbs take **ç** before **a**: *je commençais*. Before **i**, no change: *nous mangions, nous commencions*.

cases.label: hearing the imparfait
cases.rule: **-ais, -ait, -aient** all sound /ɛ/: *je parlais = il parlait = ils parlaient*. The passé composé ends in /e/: *j'ai parlé*.

sections.title: 1. The endings
text: Take the **nous** form of the present, remove **-ons**, and add the endings. It works for every verb except *être*.

examples.en: I used to play in the garden.
We lived in the countryside.

examples.fr: {Ils prenaient|imp-form} le bus tous les jours.
examples.en: They took the bus every day.

sections.tip: **faire** → nous *faisons* → je **faisais**; **avoir** → nous *avons* → j'**avais**; **aller** → nous *allons* → j'**allais**.

sections.title: 2. être: j'étais

examples.en: When I was little, I lived in Paris.
It was a lovely house.
We were very happy.

sections.tip: **Quand j'étais petit(e)…** = When I was little… is the classic way to start a childhood memory.

sections.title: 3. Habits: used to…
text: The imparfait tells what **used to happen**, again and again. English often says *used to* or *would*.

head: French
English
rows: Le dimanche, nous allions chez mes grands-parents.
On Sundays, we used to go to my grandparents'.
Tous les matins, je prenais le bus.
Every morning, I took the bus.

examples.en: On Saturdays, I used to go cycling.

examples.fr: {Tous les étés, nous allions|imp-habitude} à la mer.
examples.en: Every summer, we would go to the seaside.
My grandmother always made crêpes.

sections.tip: Words that call for the imparfait: **tous les jours, le lundi, souvent, toujours, d'habitude, chaque été**.

sections.title: 4. Describing the past
text: Use the imparfait to describe **places, people and the weather**: the background of a memory or a story.

head: French
English
rows: Ma grand-mère avait les cheveux blancs.

examples.en: The school was three kilometres away.
It used to snow a lot in winter.
My grandfather always wore a hat.

sections.title: 5. Age, feelings and wishes

head: French
English
rows: I was afraid of the dark.
I wanted to be a firefighter.

examples.fr: {J'avais dix ans|imp-etat} quand nous sommes arrivés à Lyon.
examples.en: I was ten when we arrived in Lyon.
Lou was afraid of the water.
I wanted to become a singer.

sections.tip: Age always takes **avoir**: *j'avais six ans* (never *j'étais six ans*).

sections.title: 6. il y avait, c'était, il faisait

examples.fr: {Il y avait|imp-ilyavait} une boulangerie au coin de la rue.
examples.en: There was a bakery on the corner of the street.
It was brilliant!
There was no computer.

sections.title: 7. Spelling: mangeais, commençais
text: Verbs in **-ger** keep an **e** before **a**, and verbs in **-cer** take **ç** before **a**, so the sound stays the same. Before **i** (*nous, vous*), no change.

examples.en: I used to eat lots of sweets.
School started at eight.
We often travelled by train.

sections.title: 8. Hearing the imparfait
text: **-ais, -ait, -aient** all sound the same: /ɛ/. Listen for /ɛ/ (imparfait) or /e/ (passé composé) at the end.

examples.en: I was talking with Léa.
They were playing in the garden.

story.title: Quand j'étais petite
story.en: Grandma Louise tells Léa and Lou about her childhood in a village.

lines.fr: Un soir, à Marseille, Lou demande à sa grand-mère : « Mamie, raconte ! Quand tu étais petite, c'était comment ? »
lines.en: One evening in Marseille, Lou asks her grandmother: “Grandma, tell us! When you were little, what was it like?”

lines.fr: {Quand j'étais petite|imp-etre}, {j'habitais|imp-form} dans un petit village, à la campagne.
lines.en: When I was little, I lived in a small village in the countryside.

lines.fr: {Il n'y avait pas|imp-ilyavait} de télévision, pas de téléphone portable… pas d'ordinateur !
lines.en: There was no television, no mobile phone… no computer!

lines.fr: Non ! Mais {nous jouions dehors|imp-habitude} toute la journée.
lines.en: No! But we played outside all day long.

lines.fr: {Le matin, j'allais|imp-habitude} à l'école à pied, avec mes deux frères. {L'école était|imp-description} à trois kilomètres !
lines.en: In the mornings, I walked to school with my two brothers. The school was three kilometres away!

lines.fr: En hiver, {il faisait très froid|imp-description} et {il neigeait|imp-description} souvent.
lines.en: In winter, it was very cold and it often snowed.

lines.fr: {J'avais|imp-etat} toujours froid aux mains. Mais {j'étais|imp-etat} heureuse !
lines.en: My hands were always cold. But I was happy!

lines.fr: Et qu'est-ce que tu {voulais|imp-etat} faire plus tard ?
lines.en: And what did you want to do when you grew up?

lines.fr: {Je voulais|imp-etat} être professeure. Mais {je mangeais|imp-spelling} trop de bonbons, et le dentiste, {c'était|imp-ilyavait} mon pire ennemi !
lines.en: I wanted to be a teacher. But I ate too many sweets, and the dentist was my worst enemy!
And Grandpa? Did you know Grandpa?

lines.fr: Oui ! {Il habitait|imp-form} dans la maison à côté. {Il était|imp-etre} très timide, et {il rougissait|imp-sound} quand il me parlait.
lines.en: Yes! He lived in the house next door. He was very shy, and he blushed when he talked to me.

lines.fr: {Le dimanche, on dansait|imp-habitude} sur la place du village…
lines.en: On Sundays, we used to dance in the village square…

lines.fr: Ah, ça, c'est une autre histoire ! Allez, au lit, ma puce !
lines.en: Ah, that's another story! Come on, off to bed, sweetie!

quiz.q: Quand j'étais petit, je ___ au foot tous les jours.
quiz.en: When I was little, I played football every day.
We used to live in the countryside.

options: the nous form of the present: nous parlons → parl-
the je form: je parle → parle-
quiz.answer: the nous form of the present: nous parlons → parl-

quiz.q: Quand j'___ petite, j'habitais à Lyon.
quiz.en: When I was little, I lived in Lyon.

quiz.q: « Le dimanche, nous allions chez mes grands-parents » means…
options: On Sundays, we used to go to my grandparents'.
On Sunday, we went to my grandparents'.
On Sunday, we're going to my grandparents'.
quiz.answer: On Sundays, we used to go to my grandparents'.
quiz.say: Le dimanche, nous allions chez mes grands-parents.

quiz.q: Tous les matins, il ___ le bus.
quiz.en: Every morning, he took the bus.
She was afraid of the dark.

quiz.q: How do you say “There was a bakery”?

quiz.en: I used to eat lots of sweets.
We used to start at eight.

quiz.q: Do « je parlais », « il parlait » and « ils parlaient » sound the same?
quiz.say: je parlais, il parlait, ils parlaient
